reasons: The lake identity record confirms United States v. Nathaniel Black, U.S. Court of Appeals, 4th Cir., decided 2013-02-25, docket 11-5084.

The disclosed treatment/progeny fields contain no overruling, abrogating, superseding, or limiting edge.
residual_risks: The lake treatment record is expressly unverified, with as_of_content and as_of_treatment null, so this is not an affirmative current-good-law certification.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the Unverified treatment badge adjacent to the citation wherever this case is surfaced.
